subject: The one thing I discovered about dog weight loss
preview_text: I wasn't going to send this, but the difference after 30 days is too big to ignore. See the comparison.
body_paragraphs: Picture two dogs. Same breed, same age, same starting weight. One owner is winging it, guessing portions, feeling guilty at every treat. The other has a clear plan. In 30 days, the first dog is panting after a short walk. The second is chasing balls in the park like a puppy again. Which future feels real for you right now?

That's the brutal truth of the contrast. Without a plan, it's a slow creep of worry, vet visits, and watching your best friend lose their spark. With a plan, it's visible milestones, a wagging tail at mealtime because they feel good, and the relief of knowing you're doing right by them. It's not about deprivation; it's about giving them more life.

This is exactly why the Progress Timeline in PupShape exists. It turns that vague worry into a visual story. You don't have to guess if you're on track. You see the line moving toward the goal weight. You see the before photo next to the 'now' photo. It makes the path undeniable.

Open the app right now and tap 'Progress Timeline'. Just look at it. See where you started and project where you'll be in 30 days. That visual is your secret weapon against doubt. P.S. The owners who use this feature are 3x more likely to hit their dog's goal weight. They see the proof, so they keep going.
